title: Now what? Colts should have traded Daniel Jones when they had the chance

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Now what? Colts should have traded Daniel Jones when they had the chance
sources.description: This move was nothing short of a stunner, if only from a financial standpoint. From a football standpoint, the Colts couldn't justify keeping Jones as QB1? Cutting him now, knowing what a hit they'd take? It almost feels personal.
